n = int(input())
mod = 1000000007
MOD = 998244353
maxk = 7
base = 1000000

ord = 0
ans = 0
sum_list = [0] * maxk
v = [[] for _ in range(maxk)]

def dfs1(x, length):
    global ord, sum_list, v
    ord += 1
    val = ((ord - x) % MOD + MOD) % MOD
    v[length].append(val)
    sum_list[length] = (sum_list[length] + v[length][-1]) % mod
    if length == 6:
        return
    for i in range(10):
        dfs1(x * 10 + i, length + 1)

def dfs2(x):
    global ord, ans
    if x > n:
        return
    if x * base + base - 1 <= n and x * base * 10 > n:
        now = ord
        for i in range(7):
            sz = len(v[i])
            dif = ((now - x * (10 ** i)) % MOD + MOD) % MOD
            import bisect
            pos = bisect.bisect_left(v[i], (MOD - dif) % MOD)
            ans = (ans + dif * sz + sum_list[i]) % mod
            ans = (ans - MOD * (sz - pos) % mod + mod) % mod
            ord += sz
        return
    ord += 1
    ans = (ans + ((ord - x) % MOD + MOD) % MOD) % mod
    for i in range(10):
        dfs2(x * 10 + i)

# Initialize
ord = 0
dfs1(0, 0)
for i in range(7):
    v[i].sort()
ord = 0
for i in range(1, 10):
    dfs2(i)
print(ans)
